Equipment:Gate Valves 
 4" thru 24"
 BOWELL Co. USA

These document out outlines the minor maintenance procedures P1, for the gate valves depending on external/internal 
leakage. This valve used as fully opening or closing completely (Open / Closed 
only state).

The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Abou Elfetouh Shata. tested by 
eng. 
Ali Abd Elslam and revised by Engineer Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and 
quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, accepted by general 
director eng. Yosry Abdel-Mmaqsood, and approved by eng. Fathy Ragap head sector 
of Talkha Power Station.

This document is accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS 
coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC 
planning 
and financial prediction head sector and supervisor of 
inspection and quality control head sector.

Work order must be issued and the maintenance stuff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.

items:
Work order must be issued and the maintenance stuff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety Helmet, belt, shoes,.... etc
Drain the pipeline, which connected to this valve.

Be sure the valve was out of operation and the pressure inside the pipeline 
 connected to the valve must be zero from the two end of the valve.
Be sure the pipeline is drained.
Lap the disk wear or cracks or change the defect disk.
Change the bearing if it is bad.
Make machining for stem or replace the defect.
Replace the pen if it is wear.
Retighten the gland if it is leakage or replace it.

Equipment:Gate Valves

 BOWELL Co. USA
Introduction
These document out outlines the minor maintenance procedures P1, for the gate valves depending on external/internal 
leakage. This valve used as fully opening or closing completely (Open / Closed 
only state).
Technical Specifications
The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Abou Elfetouh Shata. tested by 
eng. 
Ali Abd Elslam and revised by Engineer Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and 
quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, accepted by general 
director eng. Yosry Abdel-Mmaqsood, and approved by eng. Fathy Ragap head sector 
of Talkha Power Station.
This document is accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS 
coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC 
planning 
and financial prediction head sector and supervisor of 
inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
Work order must be issued and the maintenance stuff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Work order must be issued and the maintenance stuff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety Helmet, belt, shoes,.... etc
Isolate valve mechanically.
Drain the pipeline, which connected to this valve.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Spanner, gasket, spacer ring.
Cleaning liquid.
Blanco, anti seize.
Work to be Carried Out
Be sure the valve was out of operation and the pressure inside the pipeline 
 connected to the valve must be zero from the two end of the valve.
Be sure the pipeline is drained.
Clean from foreign material.
Lap the disk wear or cracks or change the defect disk.
Change the bearing if it is bad.
Make machining for stem or replace the defect.
Replace the pen if it is wear.
Retighten the gland if it is leakage or replace it.
